t: You're at the O2 Academy Brixton, a mid-sized concert venue in Brixton, in the London borough of Lambeth. It began as the Astoria Variety Cinema, and it has also been known as Carling Academy Brixton and simply Brixton Academy. The building was designed by Thomas Somerford, who lived from 1881 to 1948. He was a British architect, best known for the temperance movement billiard halls he designed for the Temperance Billiard Hall Company.
